in_marathi.name: Parikshit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Son of Chitrasena
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parikshit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parikshit is the name of a legendary king in Hindu mythology, the son of King Janamejaya and Rishi Chitrasena. He is known for his wisdom, courage, and strong character. Parikshit's story is a significant part of the Mahabharata, where he is predicted to have a short but eventful life. He eventually becomes the lawful heir of the Kuru kingdom.
